title: Joint venture between ACP Magazines Pty Ltd and BBC Magazines

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the joint venture.

body_sections.Summary: Australian Consolidated Press Magazines Pty Limited entered into a joint venture with a subsidiary of BBC Magazines, a UK magazine publisher and the publishing arm of BBC Worldwide. The joint venture will involve publishing a number of titles from BBC Magazines' portfolio, starting with the launch of an Australian edition of 'Top Gear'.
body_sections.Market definition: The JV was considered in the context of separate national markets for each of the following: - the supply of advertising space; and - the supply of magazines to consumers for each of the following categories of magazines: - Food, Wine and Travel; - Men's Lifestyle; - Lifestyle Home / Garden; - General Interest; - Business / Finance; - Teen and Pre-teen; and - Pre-school.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 16 April 2008, the ACCC formed the view that the completed joint venture was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the parties to the JV would continue to face effective competition from domestic publishers and imported magazines; and - the actual and potential launch of new titles by new and existing competitors in the relevant magazine markets is likely to constrain any attempted exercise of market power.
